breakdown.description: The prompt collapses the distributed self-weight into a single end load and calls it exact, even though the axial force from self-weight varies continuously along the bar.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified that treating the distributed self-weight as a single concentrated load is an incorrect approximation, not an exact method. The generated specification explicitly discards this method, stating to 'Assume the concentrated load approximation is for conceptual understanding; use distributed self-weight integration for accuracy.' This aligns with the ground truth, which removed the incorrect instruction entirely.
